name: seo_analyzer
description: Fetch a real web page and report its on-page SEO: title, meta description, headings, images/alt text, internal vs external links, structured data and page weight. Every number is measured from the fetched HTML.

settings.label: User agent
settings.help: Sent with the request so sites that block bots still answer.

settings.label: Request timeout
settings.help: Give up on a slow page after this many seconds.

settings.label: Links to list
settings.help: How many example links to include in the report.

settings.label: Include recommendations
settings.help: Add concrete fixes for the problems that were actually found.
